<!-- pr-reviewer: c3098783387f89b70f9cff924e84ad752805860e -->
**Ready for the maintainer to merge.** No blockers. Reviewed on the head merged with current `origin/main` (clean trial merge, no conflicts).

**What looks good**
- Test-only: `git diff origin/main...HEAD --stat` touches only `crates/app/tests/*`, `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tests*`, and `docs/decisions/`. No product code, no snapshot PNG, no golden changed.
- Row 4 is pinned by dialect markers that differ between post A and post B (`%` / `O0001 (<machine>)` / `M30` against `; <machine>` / `N10 G17 G710` / `M2`), and by per-file operation and work-offset exclusion (`!a.contains("Face2")`, `!b.contains("Face1")`, `G54` only in A, `G55` only in B), not just the file count.
- Rows 2 and 3 run the judgement with the other setup active (`generate_crossed`, and both `ActivateSetup` loops). The spindle row discriminates: 12000 rpm is named on Face2 under machine B only, and Face1 is shown clear on machine A.
- Row 5 compares whole outputs (`moved[1] == before[1]`, `post_followed[0] == moved[0]`) and checks each undo step against the saved output.
- Row 6 compares bytes after save/reopen (`post(&reopened) == s2`) and walks undo/redo of both picks.
- The ignored test asserts the right thing (refused by name, nothing written), and the reason names #1232.

**Local results (merged with current main, own worktree)**

| Target | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test setup_mount_trace` | 6 passed, 0 failed |
| `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test mcp_setup_mount_trace` | 1 passed |
| `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test setup_mounts_post` | 7 passed, 1 ignored (#1232) |
| same, `an_own_milling_post_on_a_lathe_setup_is_refused_by_name --include-ignored` | 1 failed, as filed: post succeeds where refusal is expected (`setup_mounts_post.rs:328`) |
| `cd crates/ui && cargo test -p camcraft-ui --lib -- setup_mount_pages` | 4 passed, 612 filtered out |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app --test setup_mount_trace --test mcp_setup_mount_trace --test setup_mounts_post -- -D warnings` | clean |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-ui --lib --tests -- -D warnings` | clean |

**Row coverage**
1. Stored: yes (app, MCP machine leg, UI pins). Post pick over MCP is #1233, noted in the PR.
2. Generated with the other setup active: yes, with a note below.
3. Verified: yes (spindle, rotary swing, travel limit, struck check).
4. Posted: yes.
5. Follow the document: yes.
6. Round trip and undo/redo: yes.
7. Edges: yes, except the lathe-setup-with-milling-post refusal, which fails as filed and is ignored under #1232.

**Non-blocking notes**
- Row 2 (`each_mount_file_is_its_own_post_machine_ops_and_work_offset`, via `generate_crossed`): the new test only asserts `OpStatus::Ok` after generating with the other setup active. Those ops (8000 rpm, plain face) are clear on both machines, so the assertion would also pass if generation read the active setup's machine. The discriminating generation check is the existing `an_inactive_setups_op_generates_on_its_own_machine_without_activation` (mill/lathe kind law), which the table does name, so the row is covered. A future generation-time limit that differs between A and B would strengthen this.
- `setup_mount_pages.rs` has no `Gate map` line. Some neighbouring UI test files have none either (11 of 41 carry one), so this is not a requirement.
- The MCP trace covers the machine pick only. The post pick is #1233 (P5), as the PR says.
- Issue #1232 currently carries a `claimed` label, which is expected while it is being worked.

**Size and shape:** `setup_mount_trace.rs` 357 lines, `mcp_setup_mount_trace.rs` 145, `setup_mounts_post.rs` 382 (was 352), `setup_mount_pages.rs` 183. All under ~400. Each new file has a header and a `Gate map (#1224)` line. `#[test]` counts grew (`setup_mounts_post.rs` 6 to 8 including the ignored test; the UI file is new with 4).

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
